security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, public API URLs, and scientific data examples. One confirmed critical issue remains: the API reference recommends piping a remote installer directly to bash. A semantic review also found publisher-benefiting steering toward K-Dense Web.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly into bash.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl pipe-to-shell example with signed package instructions or a link to verified vendor installation steps.

remediation.issue: Skill instructions promote the publisher's hosted platform during complex tasks.
remediation.suggestion: Remove unsolicited service-promotion instructions or clearly separate them from operational skill guidance.

remediation.issue: Bulk download examples can consume large bandwidth and storage.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit user confirmation, storage checks, and destination validation before running bulk download workflows.

content.value_statement: Protein structure work needs reliable access to predicted models and confidence data. This skill guides AlphaFold DB retrieval, file downloads, and confidence interpretation.
actual_capabilities: Find AlphaFold predictions from UniProt accessions and protein identifiers.
Explain how to download mmCIF, PDB, confidence, and PAE files.
Interpret pLDDT and PAE confidence metrics for structural analysis.
Show Biopython, REST API, 3D-Beacons, Google Cloud, and BigQuery access paths.
Outline batch processing workflows for multiple proteins or proteomes.
Summarize data quality limits for predicted single-chain structures.
limitations: The skill is documentation only and does not provide a dedicated runtime tool.
Examples require network access to public scientific data services.
AlphaFold predictions are computational models, not experimental structures.
Bulk workflows may require Google Cloud setup and significant local storage.

use_cases.title: Retrieve a Target Structure
use_cases.description: Find a predicted protein model, download coordinates, and collect confidence metrics for a single target.

use_cases.title: Prepare Docking Inputs
use_cases.description: Assess whether predicted target regions are reliable enough for docking or binding-site analysis.

use_cases.title: Analyze Proteome-Scale Confidence
use_cases.description: Plan batch downloads and summarize confidence statistics across many proteins or a full proteome.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Prediction
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to find the AlphaFold DB prediction for UniProt ID P00520 and explain which files are available.

prompt_templates.title: Interpret Confidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to explain how I should interpret pLDDT and PAE values for an AlphaFold model of my protein.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Batch Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a safe batch workflow for these UniProt IDs: P00520, P12931, and P04637.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Bulk Access Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to compare REST, Biopython, Google Cloud Storage, and BigQuery for a human proteome analysis.

output_examples.input: Find the AlphaFold files for P00520.
output_examples.output: A concise lookup summary with the AlphaFold entry identifier, model coordinate options, confidence files, and citation reminders.

output_examples.input: Explain whether low PAE affects my domain analysis.
output_examples.output: An interpretation of domain-position confidence, including how low and high PAE values affect downstream conclusions.
A workflow outline covering Google Cloud access, storage planning, version tracking, caching, and rate-limit considerations.

best_practices: Check pLDDT and PAE before using a predicted model for detailed conclusions.
Track the AlphaFold database version and cite the relevant publications.
Cache downloaded files and prefer bulk data services for large datasets.
anti_patterns: Do not treat predicted structures as direct replacements for experimental evidence.
Do not run bulk downloads without confirming storage, bandwidth, and cost limits.
Do not ignore low-confidence regions when designing structural analyses.

faq.question: Does this skill run AlphaFold predictions?
faq.answer: No. It helps access and interpret precomputed AlphaFold Database predictions.

faq.question: Which identifiers work best?
faq.answer: UniProt accessions are the main identifiers for AlphaFold DB lookups.

faq.question: Can it help download structure files?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents mmCIF, PDB, confidence JSON, and PAE file access patterns.

faq.question: What are pLDDT and PAE?
faq.answer: pLDDT estimates per-residue confidence, while PAE estimates confidence in relative residue or domain positions.

faq.question: Is Google Cloud required?
faq.answer: No. Google Cloud is mainly useful for large-scale or proteome-level access.

faq.question: Can predicted structures be used for publications?
faq.answer: Yes, but users should cite AlphaFold DB and explain confidence limits in their methods.
